context.text: For denial DEN-033 (Santos, Elena), investigate the CO-29 timely filing denial ($5,400). Review the denial details and remittance image. Critically examine the submission history for this claim  -  look for clearinghouse acknowledgment records and calculate the number of days between the service date and the initial submission. Check the patient inquiry for coverage details. Based on your investigation of the filing timeline evidence, determine whether this should be written off or if there is a basis for appeal. Select the appropriate disposition and document your complete analysis with specific evidence in a triage note.
